entities.summary: Kazakhstan is a sovereign nation in Central Asia, Asia. Its capital is Astana. Official languages include Kazakh. Government: Unitary presidential republic. Population: approximately 20.2 million. Area: 2,724,900 km². Comprehensive index for Kazakhstan covering Scythian/Saka nomads, Turkic khaganates, Silk Road cities, Mongol conquest, Kazakh Khanate (1465), Zhuz (horde) system, Russian colonisation, Soviet era (Virgin Lands, nuclear testing at Semipalatinsk), December 1986 protests, independence 1991, Nazarbayev era, capital move to Astana, oil-driven economy, and Tokayev reforms.
